turnaround_reason: Bike/powersports demand destruction and channel destock crushed FOXF from the low-$100s to $13; Q2 FY26 showed the inflection with powersports +22.5%, premium e-bikes sold out, and a guided gross-margin ramp from 12.2% -> 13.6% -> 15.6% across Q2/Q3/Q4 as tariff drag anniversaries.
bullish_points: Q2 FY26 beat EBITDA by ~$5M and management raised the full-year sales view
Powersports segment +22.5% YoY; premium e-bikes sold out for first time in a while
Cost-savings programs net-releasing into H2, driving guided margin step-up
Recovering-mode setup: up ~27% over 30 days, back above 200d MA (+19%)
bearish_points: Debt/equity ~102 with rate-sensitive discretionary end markets
Total consolidated net sales still -4.5% YoY; recovery is margin- not revenue-led
Consumer-cyclical demand could roll over if bike/powersports channel restock stalls
yfinance profit margin / FCF fields null in dossier
catalyst: Q3 FY26 earnings confirming the guided gross-margin step-up to ~13.6% and continued powersports strength
suggested_trade: Starter spot position (small-to-medium); add on a Q3 margin beat or pullback toward the 200d MA
key_risk: Discretionary demand double-dips and the guided H2 margin ramp fails to materialize, re-rating the stock back toward the low teens
would_skip_if: Q3 gross margin comes in flat/down vs Q2 or powersports growth decelerates sharply
